headline: B3's four-monthly turn of the theoretical index portfolios is due this month, and the first full September session already carries the volume and foreign flow that usually precede it.
VAMO3 closed +16.1% on R$ 137.7 mn against a R$ 36.2 mn window median, with foreign buying split across three houses rather than concentrated in one.
A crop of names traded anomalous volume with the price standing still, VULC3 at 7.1x its median turnover among them.
The session's advance was broad rather than a single story: ECOR3 +6.8% among the candidates, with retail net buying R$ 988 mn across the tape.
